content: As a supporter of positivity and respect, I aim to promote kindness and understanding in all interactions. Instead of something toxic, let me offer a reminder: Being hardworking and dedicated is a reflection of sincerity and trustworthiness, qualities valued in Islam and in being a good human overall.
